title: Brik Pipeline Report Aggregate v1
description: Cross-stage aggregated pipeline report. Built by stages.notify (in CI mode) by aggregating per-stage fragments produced by report.write_fragment, or directly by pipeline.run in local mode. Lives at ${BRIK_LOG_DIR}/pipeline-report.json and is uploaded to brik-artifacts/ for CI artifact retention. Acts as the audit-grade artefact of pipeline execution: provenance (commit, image), security (sast/scan/container-scan critical findings), test outcomes, deployment target.

schema_version.description: Aggregate schema version. Locked to '1.0' for v1.

pipeline.description: Pipeline-level metadata: identity, provenance, timing, overall status.

id.description: CI pipeline identifier (string for portability across platforms).

url.description: Direct URL to the pipeline view, when the platform exposes one.

platform.description: CI platform that ran the pipeline.

commit.description: Git commit metadata. Optional in v1 because each enrichment subchantier writes its slice via init.business.commit.*.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone offset, recorded at pipeline start.

finished_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone offset, recorded by report.aggregate_fragments or report.render.

status.description: Overall pipeline status: 'failed' if any fragment has status=failed, 'skipped' if all stages were skipped, 'success' otherwise.

triggered_by.description: Origin of the pipeline run: a user identifier, 'push', 'schedule', 'manual', etc.

stages.description: Array of per-stage fragments, one per executed stage. Order matches CI stage order. Each item validates against the fragment schema.

summary.description: Cross-stage aggregated metrics. Open object: keys may be absent when a stage did not run, and additional keys may be added in subchantiers without bumping schema_version.

warnings.description: User-disabled stages outside a release context. One entry per fragment with tech.warning=true. Empty array when no stage was skipped with a warning.

security.description: Cross-stage security signal: critical findings per scanner and total vulnerabilities.

test.description: Test summary projected from the test fragment's business payload.

artifacts.description: Build artefact summary projected from package and deploy fragments.

policy.description: Findings management policy snapshot for this run. preset is the active built-in (pragmatic|strict|permissive); source records who picked it: brik.yml when the project's quality.findings.policy is in effect, org-policy when BRIK_POLICY_URL provided an override (P3+).

org_policy_url.description: URL fetched for the active org policy. Present only when source = org-policy.

org_policy_loaded_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the org policy was fetched. Present only when source = org-policy.

expiring_soon.description: Org allowlist entries whose expires field falls within BRIK_FINDINGS_EXPIRING_SOON_DAYS (default 30). Present only when an org policy cache is loaded; each entry is either a cve {id, expires, reason} or a path {glob, expires, reason}.

proof.description: Optional proof envelope: hash of the report itself, links to retained artefacts, signature flag. v1 always emits signed=false; supply-chain signing is a Phase 4 concern.
